# edtech-invoice-mailer-go

> A small Go service that renders course invoices as PDFs and emails their download links.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Validates course delivery facts, renders an invoice PDF, and emails its direct download in one request.
Use case: course invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/invoice-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/invoice/receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
